title: Single easy 45min + ENERVIT CARBO GEL PRODUCT TEST
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: one session, morning, 45min flat, easier than before - Z1 to low Z2 throughout, 135-152 bpm, never above. The run is the vehicle, not the point. Legs are still clearing Tuesday's ladder.
GYM: none today - the abductor block moves to Sunday.
FUEL, THE POINT OF THE DAY: first ever exposure to Enervit Carbo Gel C2:1 Pro at rate. 2 gels, minute 15 and minute 35, each washed with 200ml water. Carry a 500ml Isocarb bottle and finish it inside the 45min - 125ml every 15min, on the clock, not to thirst. Write down what the stomach did.
STOP RULE: no symptoms during, after, or next day. This is the morning-after check on the ladder - any lateral knee signal here drops Saturday to 900m and shortens the fuel test, and that is not negotiable on the day.
WHY THE DURATION STAYS 45MIN: 30 Aug proved the rate goes down, 178g in 1h51 with a clean gut, but it proved it on SiS because of a packing error, so the race gel has still never been taken at rate. Two gels plus a 500ml bottle need the full 45min to fit. Cut the duration and gel two has nowhere to go, which makes 5 September a product test and a duration test at once - one variable too many. The intensity came down instead.
